profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Unum
profile.summary: Leader, Teammate, Innovator, Organizer, Creator, Communicator!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented big data extraction, transformation and load jobs using IBM InfoSphere tool suite
Conducted enterprise level DB2 and Teradata database analysis and population reporting
Designed and implemented continuous integration work flow for MDM 11.5 and associated WebSphere App Server
Assisted in training and configuration of multiple Agile scrum teams including the adoption of TFS and Agile Central

positions.title: Implementation Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implementations Build Deployment developer
Developed client specific code using C++ and SQL scripts
Implemented Agile methodology and participated in daily and weekly planning meetings
Developed multiple standalone tools to support business processes beyond requirements of current role
SME for multiple product specific entities as well as team lead concentrator payments platform

positions.title: Java Applications Developer
positions.description:
Completed the development, validation, and release cycles for multiple stand alone Java applications
Implemented high end functionality using Oracle connections as well as input from multiple file types
Conducted team meetings to create process specific algorithms in order to meet project requirements
Present weekly updates and progress charts to team for project discussion and high-level overview

positions.title: Junior Intern Application Assistant
positions.description:
Notes; Multiple Responsibilities:  Developed databases charts and relational diagrams
Updated database interpreter and management coding using visual basic macros
Updated graphical spreadsheet analysis and software application displays for team
Organized group project team meetings and competed in intern project competition

positions.title: Junior Intern Information Systems Assistant
positions.description:
Multiple Responsibilities: Supported company networking systems
Supported employee hardware and software information systems
Managed and operated company backup systems
Reported completed tasks via ticketing system software
